primary_text: "Interest rates make me nervous about committing to a purchase right now." We understand. But here's what most people miss — off-the-plan means you secure today's price with a deposit now and don't settle until construction completes. That gives you 12–18 months for rates to move before your loan even starts. Meanwhile, your rent keeps climbing. Every year you wait, property prices rise too. Our Truganina warehouses are 20km from Melbourne CBD, near Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel. Built for owner-occupiers. Don't let rate fear cost you more than rates ever would.
description: Secure today's price now, settle in 12–18 months — rates may drop before you pay.
